Serial constraints cleared: same-package in-flight work: PR #37145 (#37041) and branch `claude/project-thread-x90m5y` (#35863) both edit `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` and `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`. The producer goes in a sibling module; `overlap-check.mjs` runs against both before every push, and a hunk collision waits for the earlier PR to land, then rebases.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` — the producer lives in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/**`; the `ui/**` census and host wiring stay in this lane by the lane-keep rule.
Pre-claim deps: none named; source PR #35708 (#35602) merged; Approvals tab container (#35595) on main.
Prior rulings read: onviewapprovals,approval-feed,produced_feed_types → 0 hits; none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack. Seat 5 ruling B on #35602 (keep the row host-supplied until a producer exists) is what this card ends.
